_about: Where the House finds things. No secret is ever in this file: tokens come from the environment or the box's .env.
_about_alpaca_feeds: THE DATA PLAN (release R0, Oct 19, 2026; league/data_plan.py): the owner cancelled Algo Trader Plus on Oct 18, 2026 and the account is on Alpaca's free Basic plan: IEX in real time, SIP history up to 15 minutes ago, no OPRA. alpaca_feed: the bars and history (SIP; a read's end is kept 16 minutes back, a date-only end being the end of that New York day). alpaca_snapshot_feed: the live path's real-time stock snapshots, their latest quote and trade (IEX: the equity book's limits, the paper proofs, the options path's underlying price); an IEX snapshot's bars are dropped, never a store's. alpaca_option_feed: "off" refuses every option read at once with no request (opra on a plan that includes it; never indicative, which is derived and delayed).

options_structures._about: Which book the options desk's structures trade on (the House reads `book`): options-shadow, the House's own practice account over live OPRA quotes (league/options_shadow.py), or alpaca-paper, the Alpaca practice account's multi-leg route. The shadow account's starting_cash matters only when options-shadow.json does not exist yet: 20 structure agents' practice stakes of $200 are $4,000.
options_structures._about_practice_account: Wave 2 (Sept 25, 2026): true sends each structure agent whose program's PARAMS["structure"] is one of the five types the Alpaca practice account can close as ONE covered multi-leg order (debit_vertical, credit_vertical, iron_condor, iron_butterfly, long_butterfly) to alpaca-paper; every other structure agent stays on `book`. An agent holding structures on its old book keeps trading there until flat (opens through one full session, then closes only), then its practice stake moves (House._structure_move). Keep `book` at options-shadow. False: every structure agent on `book`, as before. Deploy G ships it false; turn it on ONLY in a later release that changes nothing but this key, and undo it the same way (a release setting it false). NEVER roll back past Deploy G while alpaca-paper holds a structure: the older code cannot read the account's legs (alpaca-paper freezes for every agent) and its wind-down sells a structure as its first leg alone, a naked short (House._structure_practice_account).

_about_options_history_daily_expiries: The review of Deploy G (Sept 25, 2026): true makes the House's daily options-history refresh ingest EVERY expiry of SPY, QQQ and IWM (league/options_history.py DAILY_EXPIRIES) and backfill them across the replay window once; false keeps the weekly refresh (the last expiry of each week), as before G. Deploy G ships it false. Turn it on ONLY in a later release that changes nothing but this key, in an announced, watched quiet slot (the backfill holds an ops slot for tens of minutes and thousands of gateway GETs), recording House RSS and tick time during it and at the first every-expiry structure tape. Once the store holds every expiry, NEVER roll back past Deploy G without first deleting the non-weekly SPY/QQQ/IWM bars: the older code's tape has no weekly filter and would build tapes about four times the size (House._options_history_daily_expiries).
_about_real_money: The options overhaul (Sept 26, 2026, plan Wave 7): the new House's first owner deploy runs with real_money false; real money turns on only with the live path (Wave 5, M4b) in a second owner deploy, and then only under the grant (live_trading, league/live_trading.py).

live_trading._about: The owner's grant of real money, options-swarm-20260928 (league/live_trading.py): the Brokerage Account only. Its capital is the lower of the account's equity and ceiling_usd at each ratification (scripts/live_trading.py --enable / --ratify on the box); a deposit is answered by --ratify. Sept 26, 2026: $481.62 of cash plus the owner's planned $5,000 deposit.

_about_performance: The record's first point for the options swarm: the site's reset of Sept 26, 2026 at 07:21Z used start_at 06:25:30Z (the moment Wave 0 closed the Brokerage Account's leftovers) and start_equity 481.65 (its equity then); capital.js PERFORMANCE_START_AT is the same instant. Deposits and withdrawals are never profit: the publisher nets the account's funding flows since start_at.

backup._about: Which box the House's daily checkpoint (league/backup.py) backs up: the House box, pinned here by id and name (the same box as gateway/wrangler.jsonc SAILBOX_ID). This pin wins over the box id in Sail's environment. The House box was forked from a running box, so an id it inherited can be stale, and the retired ltcm-floor box still exists. When the environment names another box, the House warns once and backs up this one. When the House moves to another box, change both keys. With no pin and no id in the environment, the backup fails and says why; it never falls back to a name.

live._about: The live options path (league/live/, the options swarm's Wave 5, Sept 26, 2026): Candidates trade the shadow book on live quotes (the Gym's own fill rules), Probe and Sized families trade real money under the constitution's options_money table and the grant, the practice account proves the multi-leg route first. enabled: it runs, and it owns both Alpaca accounts (no old Book is built for them). require_paper_proof: real opens wait for the practice account's multi-leg round trip. shadow_capital: each shadow instance's notional capital (the Gym's). The House box needs numpy. observe_max_sessions: a practice cohort's session window (league/live/step.py DEFAULTS 10; Oct 8, 2026: 30, so a cohort under the practice cap of 3 open structures can reach the incubator's 10 program closes before its window ends; the House reads it at its start, for the cohorts already active too, and league/swarm/practice.py COHORT_WINDOW mirrors it).

gym._about: The Gym (Wave 3, league/gym/): sealed Sailboxes forked from the Gym image that replay agent programs over recorded one-minute NBBO. A placeholder until the Gym's builder fills it; nothing reads it yet.

swarm._about: The swarm (Wave 4, league/swarm/): 48 researcher families in the Gym, the hourly tournament and bandit, the architect, the gate. Its own process beside the House (python -m league.swarm run), kept alive by the House's swarm step. Every key here (league/swarm/settings.py DEFAULTS) can be overridden without a deploy in <state>/swarm.json, including enabled and the gym block's image_checkpoint/gate_checkpoint; a change of enabled takes a House restart (it decides births and the old research at build). Enabled, the House seats no agent of its own and builds no old research or Merton.

events._about: THE EVENT LANE ON THE HOUSE (release R1, the goal of Oct 19, 2026; league/events/house.py, docs/events.md): enabled runs the lane's scheduler beside the House's tick, on the House box's own loop only (never a canary), with its store at <state>/events/ (events.sqlite and docs/), the House's gateway token and its SEC contact. A missing key or false is OFF. Switched on, the lane waits (records nothing) until its store exists: scripts/evl_migrate.py copies blake-desktop's there once, and refuses a store that is not empty. verdict_usd_day: the lane's own line on its Claude verdicts a day (USD; R3's births call counts in it too), held on the UTC day from release 1019c (the budget rule's day; New York days before it) beside the budget rule's allowance for the lane, whichever is lower; over it a READ event waits for the next day's verdicts (PREREG-EVL-1 section 4), as for any call that gets no answer. $6.00 from release 1019m-cost (A145): the owner's goal V3, item 5 (metered compute <= $10 a day plus half the trailing week's realized net profit, never above $50), budget rule 4, whose lane part at no profit is $6.00 of the $10 base, the same share as goal V2's $3.00 of its $5 (from release 1019b's second review to release 1019l: the House box's about $1.29 a day plus the verdicts' $3.00 inside the $5 base); budget rule 4 holds it, with every other metered dollar, under the day's cap. Release 1019b ships enabled true (the lane on the House beside its real money; the desktop's timers stop at the migration); false is the deploy that switches the lane off. births (R3, goal-2026-10-19/R3-SPEC.md; league/events/births.py): true runs the births job on a session night at 21:15 ET after the report (the outcome-free facts, the architect's one call a night, claude-opus-5-5 from release 1019h (A109: no sampling parameter, effort low; claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 at temperature 0 before it), under $0.25 a night, the validator with its stated false-pass budget of 0.10 a seatable birth and the lane's 3.0 in all, counted from every seatable version ever registered (A81), and the registration of the accepted specs as lines of docs/births/<night>.jsonl through the gateway's docs route, whose commit time is each birth's registration). It needs the gateway release that admits docs/births/ appends; a missing key or false is off. A registered birth is loaded and trades at learning size whatever this says: the switch stops new births only. score_batch (release 1019i, PREREG-EVL-8's harness plan H1; league/events/score.py): the batched score, on by default (a missing key is on): the nightly score prefetches every due intent's daily bars and both benchmarks' in one read of 200 symbols a request and settles each with no bar request of its own; false restores release 1019h's per-intent path (the instant rollback). score_parity: true checks a 5% sample against the per-intent path every night, false never; missing, on the first batched night only (equality flags, no value). px_data (release 1019i, PREREG-EVL-8's harness plan H2; league/events/pxdata.py): true runs the price lane's recorders into <state>/events/px.sqlite (the 270-session daily backfill and the operating-company cache on the first nights, the nightly bars, the PX universe, FLAGGED and the minute marks), last of the lane's tasks, never within 10 minutes of a decision, bounded and through the lane's bucket after the lane's own reads; they only warm the store (no decision reads it before PREREG-EVL-8's programs ship). Missing or false is off.
